saw_lines: Custom shoe buyers want to see their own design on a real pair before they trust a maker with money.
So the sale is lost when a designer cannot see a finished pair before signing up for a line.
Your site runs four customer quotes and we found no proof number, so add your finished pair count to the homepage and open your one Google image ad with it.
ads_1: Paid test: finished custom pairs on a real foot, led by the designer’s name.
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
